items.title: SK Hynix (KOSE:A000660) Unveils Open AI Memory Standard Through New HBF Spec
items.summary: SK hynix (KOSE:A000660) and Sandisk have released a new High Bandwidth Flash technical specification through the Open Compute Project. The High Bandwidth Flash standard is designed for AI inference systems and targets high bandwidth and high capacity memory and storage use cases. The open specification gives system designers a common framework for integrating AI focused memory technologies across future infrastructure. The move is expected to broaden SK hynix's role within the AI ecosystem...

items.title: Micron Stock Edges Back Toward $1,000. How Far It Could Go.
items.summary: Micron Technology  stock is almost back up to $1,000 a share, and Wall Street is confident the memory-chip maker has further to go.  The memory chip maker’s stock has already risen 12% in the past month, although it is trading well below its late June peak of more than $1,200.  The key factor is that memory prices are expected to keep surging.
